{{Quote|Finn, there's another skimmer.|Jannah to Finn|<ref name="Episode 9">{{Film|VIII}}</ref>}}
'''Sea skiff number two''' was the second of two [[sea skiff]]s constructed and used by [[Company 77]], a group of [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] who defected from the [[First Order]] and resided on the [[ocean]] [[moon]] [[Kef Bir]]. After [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] took [[sea skiff number one]] to the [[Death Star ruins|ruins]] of the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station]], [[Jannah]] and [[Finn]] followed in sea skiff number two.<ref name="TROS VD" />
